id.description: Unique identifier for the header component

projectTitle.description: Title of the project, displayed in the header

projectLogo.description: (OPTIONAL) URL of the logo image to display in the header in place of the project title

projectUrl.description: URL for the project title or logo link

navSections.description: Array of menu section objects with 'title', and mutually exclusive 'links' or 'href' properties

secondaryLinks.description: Array of secondary link objects with 'href' and 'text' properties

searchConfig.description: (OPTIONAL) Configuration object for the search component, with 'action' and 'placeholder' properties

extended.description: Whether to use the extended header style with larger logo and search input

megamenu.description: Whether to use the megamenu style for the navigation sections

useMenuIcon.description: Whether to use a menu icon instead of the word 'Menu' for the mobile menu toggle button

styles.description: Inline styles for the header component
